viewing_check: Open each box: count rails per box, check for rust, bent sleepers and missing pieces, and check the level crossing is complete (gates and base) and the paint is intact. Boxed Hornby O gauge accessories only sell for modest money, so condition and completeness matter most. Photograph the box ends for the item numbers.
